admitted_checkout.operatorAction: Hold the campaign on the exact detached admitted checkout and preserve a clean working tree.
admitted_checkout.nextSafeAction: Restore and verify the exact detached admitted checkout before producing any campaign receipt.
admitted_checkout.wakeCondition: The repository resolves to the required full commit and tree, is detached, and has no tracked or untracked change.
admitted_checkout.repairAction: Quarantine the workstation until the repository is restored to the exact admitted detached checkout and every local change is removed or moved elsewhere.
admitted_checkout.controlQuestion: Is this the exact admitted source tree, detached from every moving branch and unchanged since admission?

artifact_coordinates.operatorAction: Maintain the four declared private artifact coordinates as distinct, existing, non-symlink sources outside the workstation output roots.
artifact_coordinates.nextSafeAction: Restore the declared cartridge, model or executable, independent verifier, and storage substrate at their immutable campaign coordinates.
artifact_coordinates.wakeCondition: All four required artifact labels resolve to distinct existing regular files or directories without path overlap.
artifact_coordinates.repairAction: Refuse the changed coordinate set and initialize a new campaign root rather than editing the admitted campaign configuration.
artifact_coordinates.controlQuestion: Do the four declared coordinates still identify the exact private inputs this campaign is allowed to hash and use?

readiness.operatorAction: Run the admitted readiness census against the exact checkout and declared artifacts.
readiness.nextSafeAction: Run the admitted local-toolchain doctor transaction into the generated preparation root.
readiness.wakeCondition: A content-valid readiness-private receipt binds the exact commit, clean detached checkout, exact HALO3 Seat identity and transport ancestry, current CUDA-index observation, and all four declared artifact coordinates.
readiness.repairAction: Remove the invalid preparation root from campaign consideration, preserve it for diagnosis, and rerun doctor into a new campaign root if the receipt cannot be reproduced exactly.
readiness.controlQuestion: Did the readiness receipt observe this exact source checkout and every declared private artifact without widening authority?

feed.operatorAction: Generate the admitted deterministic invented feed at the frozen dimensions and seed.
feed.nextSafeAction: Run generate-feed for 262144 records, 32 features, 8 classes, and seed 20260827 into the generated feed root.
feed.wakeCondition: The admitted feed validator accepts the manifest, binary denominator, header, dimensions, seed, and feature digest.
feed.repairAction: Refuse the altered or unrelated feed root and regenerate the feed at the frozen dimensions and seed.
feed.controlQuestion: Does the feed close its exact byte and record denominator while remaining invented, local, and non-authoritative?

personal_floor.operatorAction: Run and independently verify the accepted workload on the resident CPU floor before HALO3 is attached.
personal_floor.nextSafeAction: Run the Python resident-floor workload and its independent stdlib verification against the admitted feed.
personal_floor.wakeCondition: A valid resident-CPU result and PASS verification bind the exact admitted feed and one accepted semantic output.
personal_floor.repairAction: Refuse the altered, unrelated, shortened, or non-resident result pair and repeat the resident-floor transaction.
personal_floor.controlQuestion: Did the resident floor produce and independently verify the accepted output without optional accelerator capacity?

halo3.operatorAction: Run and independently verify the same feed through the selected torch-cuda device.
halo3.nextSafeAction: Resolve the immutable HALO3 Seat, run the torch-cuda workload on its currently observed CUDA index, and independently verify its output.
halo3.wakeCondition: A valid torch-cuda result bound to the exact GPU UUID, PCI/PnP identity, and Thunderbolt transport preserves the baseline semantic and classification identities and exceeds baseline throughput.
halo3.repairAction: Refuse the non-matching, non-accelerating, wrong-Seat, wrong-transport, synthetic, or unrelated result and rerun the HALO3 audition.
halo3.controlQuestion: Did HALO3 accelerate the same accepted result on the selected seat without becoming necessary or authoritative?

post_halo3_continuity.operatorAction: Apply the declared reversible HALO3 interruption, rerun the resident floor, independently verify it, and compare all three results.
post_halo3_continuity.nextSafeAction: Perform the declared reversible interruption and complete the post-removal resident run, verification, and three-way comparison.
post_halo3_continuity.wakeCondition: The continuity result reproduces the baseline identities and the comparison proves one accepted output, measured HALO3 acceleration, and resident continuity.
post_halo3_continuity.repairAction: Refuse the mismatched or incomplete continuity chain and repeat the reversible interruption and post-removal proof.
post_halo3_continuity.controlQuestion: After HALO3 became unavailable, did the resident floor reproduce the accepted output with no loss of canonical state or authority?

two_cell_partition.operatorAction: Build two complete offline cells, verify them on distinct actual host classes, and reunite them without selecting a winner.
two_cell_partition.nextSafeAction: Execute the admitted two-cell build, distinct-host private attestations, and HUMAN_REQUIRED reunion transaction.
two_cell_partition.wakeCondition: A valid private_local_attested two-cell verification preserves both divergent branches, distinct host classes, automaticMergeAllowed false, and one unresolved obligation.
two_cell_partition.repairAction: Hold synthetic evidence and refuse altered or collapsed reunion evidence; repeat the physical two-cell transaction without selecting either branch.
two_cell_partition.controlQuestion: Did the physical partition and reunion preserve both independently verified branches and leave disposition with the named human?

successor_head.operatorAction: Build the complete successor bundle and verify it on a replacement HEAD class without repository history or the original host.
successor_head.nextSafeAction: Execute the admitted cold-successor build and private_local_attested verification on a distinct replacement HEAD class.
successor_head.wakeCondition: A valid private_local_attested successor verification closes the complete denominator, six-question reconstruction, obligation preservation, and absent-dependency set.
successor_head.repairAction: Hold synthetic evidence and refuse altered, same-host, incomplete, or dependency-widening successor evidence; repeat the cold-successor transaction.
successor_head.controlQuestion: Can the replacement HEAD reconstruct the cartridge, state, authority boundary, evidence, obligations, and next safe action without the original host or repository history?

flight_plan.operatorAction: Compile the admitted flight plan from the exact private receipts and bind the generated packet configuration.
flight_plan.nextSafeAction: Run compile-plan with the readiness, feed, three workload results, private two-cell verification, and private successor verification.
flight_plan.wakeCondition: The content-valid plan binds this campaign and exact commit, all eight gates are READY, and the generated packet configuration contains no placeholder.
flight_plan.repairAction: Refuse an altered or unrelated plan; when a valid plan remains held, satisfy its first exact gate wake condition and compile a new plan root.
flight_plan.controlQuestion: Do all eight admitted gates close from exact campaign receipts without converting synthetic or absent evidence into readiness?

private_packet.operatorAction: Initialize, configure, and record all sixteen admitted packet stages in order with named-human confirmation and local evidence.
private_packet.nextSafeAction: Use the rendered packet handoff, then perform and record only the packet runtime’s next admitted stage.
private_packet.wakeCondition: The admitted packet validator accepts the campaign binding and all sixteen stages are recorded sequentially with nextStage null.
private_packet.repairAction: Refuse altered packet state or out-of-order evidence; return to the admitted packet runtime and reproduce the next valid state without editing recorded receipts.
private_packet.controlQuestion: Has the named human completed only the next admitted stage, supplied local evidence, and preserved every terminal and authority boundary?

sealed_flight.operatorAction: Seal the complete private packet, independently verify the sealed denominator, and retain only the body-free disposition for public review.
sealed_flight.nextSafeAction: Run the admitted seal and detached verify-sealed transactions, then generate the conductor public projection.
sealed_flight.wakeCondition: The admitted sealed-package verifier returns PASS and the public disposition remains body-free with every stronger qualification and authority field false or none.
sealed_flight.repairAction: Refuse the drifted, incomplete, or claim-widening sealed package and return to the private packet without publishing any disposition.
sealed_flight.controlQuestion: Does the sealed package prove one completed private self-attestation while keeping every private body local and every stronger qualification ungranted?

claimBoundary: Source-pinned private-flight orchestration contract. It derives progress only from admitted receipts, performs no physical action, creates no evidence body, and grants no hardware, model, verifier, scheduler, transport, physical-Estate, representative-operator, field-network, operational-C2, production-Lattice, mission, command, targeting, engagement, effector, or weapons qualification or authority.
